specs: How close do we get to the whales and dolphins? >The Marine Mammal Protection Act requires that we stay 100 yards away from the whales, but some may swim right up to the boat!
Dolphins usually come very close, but we do not touch, swim with, or feed the wildlife.
Can I bring my own food and/or beverages? >No hot food or Alcohol may be brought on board.

Alcohol may not be brought on board.
